name: CodeBlock
description: Framed code surface. Compose a header and a body inside it.

props.name: defaultWrap
props.description: Soft-wrap the block's long lines when it mounts, instead of scrolling them sideways. Pass it for code in a message; leave it off where people read code as code (a diff, a full code view). A `CodeBlockWrapToggle` switches this one block afterwards; nothing is remembered.

name: CodeBlockPre
description: The code's `pre`. In a block that wraps (`defaultWrap`, until its `CodeBlockWrapToggle` is pressed) long lines wrap inside it. Otherwise a long line scrolls inside it; while it does, it is a named region the keyboard can reach (`tabindex="0"`, `role="region"`, its `aria-label`, "Code" by default), since Safari doesn't focus a scroller on its own. Code that fits adds no Tab stop.

name: CodeBlockWrapToggle
description: Switches its block between wrapping long lines and scrolling them sideways: a Base UI Toggle, pressed (`aria-pressed`, the yellow sticker) while the block scrolls. Place it in `CodeBlockActions`, before Copy. It changes only its own block. The consumer gives the icon and the `aria-label`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the component should ignore user interaction.

props.name: nativeButton
props.description: Whether the component renders a native `<button>` element when replacing it via the `render` prop. Set to `false` if the rendered element is not a button (for example, `<div>`).

props.name: onPressedChange
props.description: Callback fired when the pressed state is changed.
